basic_details.job_title: ICAR CRRI Senior Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Update 19 Nov 2026: Applications re-opened, last date now 18 January 2027. A fresh circular dated 17 November 2026 also allows applications by post, gives the email addresses and encloses the application proforma.

qualification.details: Sr. Medical Officer: MBBS Degree from any college/University/Institute recognized by the MCI or any other organization governing the Medical Education/Profession in the country. Desirable: Master's Degree from any College/University/Institute recognized by the MCI or any other organization governing the Medical Education/Profession in the country. Candidates must be officers holding analogous posts under Central / State Government / Union Territories / Autonomous Bodies / PSU on a regular basis who have completed the period of probation satisfactorily.

salary_details.details: Level-10 of the 7th CPC + NPA as per Government of India Rules

selection_process: Deputation/Transfer basis Forwarding of applications with APAR/CR dossiers No disciplinary/vigilance case certificate Only candidates who can be relieved immediately on selection should be forwarded Deputation will be initially for three years
regulated as per ICAR guidelines / Government of India Rules
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for ICAR CRRI Sr. Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.

Fill in the Application Proforma enclosed with the notification and have it forwarded with your up-to-date APAR/CR dossiers for the last five years and the certificate from the Head of Department/Office that no disciplinary/vigilance case is pending or contemplated.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.

Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification ([email protected] or [email protected]), or by post to ICAR-Central Rice Research Institute, Cuttack, Odisha - 753006.
Ensure the email or postal application reaches the office on or before the last date: 18-01-2027.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR CRRI Sr. Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application by post and/or email is 18 January 2027. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Sr. Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree. A Master's Degree is considered desirable for this position.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for this government job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted by post and/or email ([email protected] or [email protected]). You need to send your resume and required documents to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Sr. Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary as per Level-10 of the 7th CPC plus Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Sr. Medical Officer.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of selection for this post?
faq.answer: The selection will be made on a deputation/transfer basis, which involves forwarding of applications with APAR/CR dossiers and a certificate confirming no disciplinary/vigilance cases.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the ICAR Central Rice Research Institute located?
faq.answer: The institute is located in Cuttack, Odisha, with the pincode 753006.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from any state apply for this position?
faq.answer: This is a government job, and candidates from eligible backgrounds can apply. The institute is located in Odisha.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I attach with my application?
faq.answer: You should attach self-attested copies of all required documents, including educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
